row.text: "He who runs away lives to fight another day!" - so the foul, craven adage goes.
Skaven are craven by nature but take courage when in packs of their own kind, where they move slower but enjoy the safety of numbers.
Charge Defence vs. Large||When bracing[[img:icon_braced]][[/img]], this unit negates the [[img:icon_charge]][[/img]]charge bonus of any large attacker.
Charge Reflection||When [[img:icon_braced]][[/img]]bracing, this unit causes additional damage when attacking charging enemies.
Hide (forest)||This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.
Some warriors care not for their own personal safety, and so work themselves into a whirlwind of destruction and mindless violence!
Immune to Psychology||The unit is immune to psychological attacks (Fear & Terror).
When a bomb is smashed, a dark smoke curls out, concealing those who wish to hide and choking everyone else.
Stalk||This unit can move hidden in any terrain.
Strider||Speed and combat penalties caused by terrain are ignored by this unit.
Unspottable||If this unit can hide at its current location it will not be spotted until the enemy is very close.
Like their huge, earth-boring equivalents, Warp-Grinders can turn solid rock into dust on a smaller scale, halting enemies’ movements by pulverising the ground beneath them.
Warp-energy channelled directly into the ground causes the earth to tremble at a frequency that causes brains to rattle within skulls and bones to splinter!

Wallbreaker||Allows the unit to attack and destroy walls in melee. This attribute also adds a [[img:ui/skins/default/weapon_building_damage_modifier.png]][[/img]] [[col:green]]+50%[[/col]] damage multiplier against buildings.
Snare-nets are lightweight but strong and covered in hooks. They are used by Gutter Runners to capture live prisoners.

row.localised_description: An invisible network of sneaky, backstabbing operatives makes Eshin the Skaven’s most feared clan, led by the most dreaded assassin of them all. When the Deathmaster is unleashed upon a target, there is not a king, noble, chief or warlord who is safe from the deadly steel blur of his whip-like tail.

Stopped by Medium targets, slows as it passes through entities

row.localised_description: Larger enemy-things can endure globadiers' poisoned winds. But if laced with needle-thin Warpstone shards, even the thickest skin would provide no defence.

Stopped by Small targets, slows as it passes through entities

row.localised_description: Warpstone gas rakes flesh, but a strong mind might endure the agony unless the brew is infused with an unspeakable offal found only in the Plague Monks' rancid cells...

row.text: Expendable||Witnessing friendly expendable units rout does not reduce other units' [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership, unless they are themselves expendable.

Stopped by Small targets, slows as it passes through entities

row.localised_description: Enemies previously outside of the Warpfire Thrower’s reach will now be just as flame-grilled as everything else that dares come near!

row.text: Cannot Run||This unit cannot run and will only move at walking pace.

row.text: From within the Realm of Souls – Nehekhara’s revered afterlife – deceased warriors are called forth and bound to mortal remains, to find purpose once again through war.
The spirits of warriors slain can be summoned from the Realm of Souls and bound to corporeal bodies, so that they may fight for the Tomb Kings as they did in life.
The Liche Priests use the very breath of Nehekhara’s gods to reach into the Realm of Souls, retrieving the spirits of dead soldiers for binding and eternal service to their Tomb King’s will.
The Dark Magic that holds these subjects together has failed. As the Necromantic energy flows out of them, nothing is left but a pile of iron and bones in the sand.
In the blasted desert of deepest Nehekhara, the dead rarely remain so. Those dragged back to screaming, clanking Unlife are bound forever to the Tomb King whose will they exist only to serve.
Causes Fear||This unit frightens all enemy units, reducing their [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership when nearby. It is also immune to fear. Fear penalties do not stack.

row.localised_description: Khalida Neferher, the Warrior-Queen of Lybaras, is highly respected across all the lands of Nehekhara. Her intelligence and bravery are as legendary as her intense sense of honour and justice.

row.text: Constructs are inanimate objects given form and purpose through magical means. When that magic wavers and ebbs, as it inevitably will, it's immensely difficult to keep one 'alive' and in one piece.
Now that the sorcery that holds this Construct together has failed, the Winds of Magic flow out of it, leaving naught but an empty, static husk behind.

Construct||[[b]][[col:white]]Constructs[[/col]][[/b]] cannot be [[img:icon_rout]][[/img]]routed, but take damage when their [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]{{tr:morale}} is broken.\\n\\n[[b]][[col:white]]Constructs[[/col]][[/b]] also have:\\n[[img:bullet_point]][[/img]] [[img:icon_fear]][[/img]]Fear and [[img:icon_terror]][[/img]]Terror Immunity\\n\\n[[b]][[col:white]]Constructs[[/col]][[/b]] may also have their [[img:icon_hp]][[/img]]hit points restored and stats boosted by special characters such as the Tomb Kings Necrotect.
